notes: Physics step rate at 240 frames per second: two seconds of frames must simulate exactly 480 fixed 12.5 ms steps on both sides. The demo steps one fixed step per rendered frame; the browser is paced through checks/plugins/raf-pacing.init.js and observed headed so the display's real cadence is measured.

hooks.inject: globalThis.__bblRafPacing(240); globalThis.__physicsTiming = { world, scene, samples: [] }; world._afterStep ??= []; world._afterStep.push((seconds) => globalThis.__physicsTiming.samples.push({ seconds, now: performance.now() }));

actions.evaluate: (() => { const { world, scene, samples } = globalThis.__physicsTiming; return { sceneFixed: scene.fixedDeltaMs ?? 0, worldFixed: world._fixedDeltaMs, dynamicBodies: world._bodies.filter((body) => body.motionType === 2).length, samples: samples.slice(0, 481) }; })()
